title: Director of Manufacturing Engineering, EW
tags: Manufacturing : EW Manufacturing Engineering : Manufacturing Engineering
description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Anduril's Electromagnetic Warfare (EW) Manufacturing team is responsible for rapidly iterating and building cutting-edge defense hardware for Electromagnetic Warfare. This responsibility spans the full manufacturing value chain - from Design for Manufacturability through full-rate production - including tool design and selection, process creation and optimization, vendor sourcing, quality planning, system integration, and work documentation for the hardware our engineers own.

ABOUT THE JOB

As the Director of Manufacturing Engineering for EW, you will provide strategic oversight and tactical management of manufacturing engineering to support both the development of new products and the scaling of high-volume production. You are charged with ensuring rigorous manufacturing processes are in place, resulting in the consistent delivery of superior quality defense hardware to our customers. Your leadership will guarantee the fulfillment of manufacturing capacity commitments while driving advancements in tools, automation, and methodologies to improve design, analysis, and execution. This role demands an innovative and adaptable leader who thrives in a fast-paced, resource-constrained environment solving complex manufacturing challenges for electromechanical defense systems.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Build & Lead the Manufacturing Engineering Team : Recruit, mentor, and develop a high-performing team of manufacturing engineers with deep product knowledge in mechanical, electrical, system integration, and environmental testing. Foster a culture of innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement across the organization.

• Drive Manufacturing Strategy & Technology: Develop and implement a long-term manufacturing engineering strategy aligned with Anduril EW's growth objectives. Drive adoption of automation, advanced manufacturing technologies, and digital manufacturing tools to enhance efficiency and scalability across development and high-volume production.

• Lead New Product Introduction (NPI): Partner with Design Engineering teams in early to late phases of the development process to ensure seamless transition of new products from design to production. Champion Design for Manufacturability (DfM), Design for Assembly (DfA), and broader DFx principles to de-risk production scaling.

• Scale Production Capability : Evaluate, plan, and prioritize supply chain, production, and test optimizations to ensure the value stream can reliably meet production output goals. Develop process flows that break down large, complex electromechanical assemblies into logical subassemblies and sub-processes. Build business cases for vertical integration or supplier diversification where strategic partnerships will accelerate scalability.

• Drive Continuous Improvement & Quality: Lead initiatives to improve yield, reduce cycle time, and lower cost across the manufacturing value chain. Drive operational excellence through Kaizen events, RCCA burndowns, component and supplier rationalization, and process standardization. Be a strong partner with Product Quality Engineering to tackle key issues both internally and externally to EW Production.

description:
Paralegal Jobs - London and Regional
The Role
By applying for this role you are not applying for a specific paralegal position. Instead, you are applying to be added to our successful candidates database for paralegal job opportunities.
If successful, we would take the time to understand your preferences, experience and interests, in order to match those with paralegal opportunities available with our clients. These include paralegal jobs in both law firms and in-house teams, from boutique firms doing niche areas of law to international and US firms, but also banks, financial institutions, media and entertainment companies and much more! Our clients cover a wide range of practice areas.
Opportunities vary from short paralegal roles of a few weeks to longer placements lasting for a few months, but also permanent positions where you would be hired directly by our clients.
The Selection Process
We would review your application and if your skills, experience and qualifications match our requirements, we will contact you to schedule an interview with a member of our recruitment team.
What we look for

• A law degree or equivalent (LLB/GDL or SQE1) is beneficial and may mean more opportunities will be open to you as some clients require a degree of previous legal training.

• Previous experience of working within a legal environment is an advantage, but not essential.

Additional Requirements
In general, we are looking for candidates that can demonstrate good core competencies.

• Highly organised

• Excellent communication skills

• Demonstrate strong attention to detail

• Technologically proficient

• Capable of working on your own as well as part of a team

• Confident with good emotional intelligence

When to apply
As paralegal job opportunities arise throughout the year, it is advisable to get your application in to us as quickly as possible. During the selection process we will discuss with you the type of experience you are looking to gain.

title: 3D Artist (Blender & Real-Time Specialist)
description:
Job Spec: 3D Artist (Blender & Real-Time Specialist)

Location: Remote

Reporting to: Creative Director

The Role

We are looking for a versatile and technically proficient 3D Artist to join our growing creative team. You will be responsible for bringing complex concepts to life through high-quality modeling and fluid animation, primarily using Blender. As we specialize in interactive web-based demos, your primary challenge will be the "magic trick" of 3D: making assets look like high-end cinema while keeping them lightweight enough to load

instantly in a mobile browser. You will work under our Creative Director and alongside our development team to bridge the gap between high-fidelity art and web performance.

Key Responsibilities

• Modeling & Texturing: Create high-quality 3D assets optimized for performance. This includes expert-level retopology and baking high-to-low poly details.

• Animation: Develop smooth, purposeful animations-ranging from mechanical movements to

environmental storytelling-using Blender’s animation suite.

• Web Optimization: Ensure all assets are "game-ready" for the browser, focusing on low draw calls, efficient texture atlasing, and minimal file sizes.

• Collaboration: Work alongside other 3D artists and frontend developers to ensure visual consistency and technical compatibility.

• Pipeline Integration: Prepare and export assets (primarily glTF/GLB) that are ready for immediate implementation into our interactive platforms.

Technical Requirements

• Blender Mastery: Advanced proficiency in modeling, retopology, rigging, shading, and animation.

• Real-Time Optimization: Proven experience creating assets for web-based engines (Three.js, Babylon.js, or PlayCanvas). You should be an expert in:

○ Polygon Budgeting: Keeping mesh density low without losing silhouette.

○ Texture Compression: Efficient use of 1k/2k textures and PBR workflows.

○ Draw Call Reduction: Merging meshes and materials strategically.

• Visual Flair: A strong portfolio demonstrating a mastery of lighting and material creation.

Bonus Points

• Development Experience: Experience working directly within a dev sprint, using version control (Git), or understanding the limitations of WebGL.

• Technical Art: Knowledge of Python scripting within Blender to automate export pipelines.

• Material Science: Experience with KHR extensions for glTF (clearcoat, transmission, sheen) to achieve high-end looks in the browser.

Why Us?

We create virtual instrument simulations for lab equipment - helping people learn and service. We work with global biotech companies and we are always pushing boundaries with technical and creative ideas.

title: SEM Technician (f/m/d)
description:
Your Role

As an SEM Technician (f/m/d), you will support tools and process qualifications and help investigate issues arising across our semiconductor process flow. Working closely with our Failure Analysis Engineer, Process Integration team and other engineering functions, you will perform Scanning Electron Microscopy (SEM) analysis and complementary characterization using techniques such as Energy-Dispersive X-ray Spectroscopy (EDX) and Focused Ion Beam (FIB).

Ideally you come with a first-hand experience working with SEM. You will initially work alongside our SEM experts to deepen your knowledge learn the tool’s operating principles, procedures and inspection requirements for our specific use cases. Through hands-on training and continuous knowledge transfer, you will build your skills in sample handling, imaging, measurement and troubleshooting; before gradually becoming an independent SEM user and taking greater ownership of the tool and the processes.

As the function develops, there may also be opportunities to operate additional defect-inspection tools and support defect analysis and yield improvement within our 300 mm manufacturing facility.

What You’ll Do

- Prepare, handle and inspect a wide range of semiconductor samples according to defined analysis requirements

- Perform accurate and reliable SEM analysis to support tool qualification, process qualification and root-cause investigations

- Use complementary characterization techniques, including EDX and FIB, where required

- Work closely with Failure Analysis, Process Integration and engineering teams to understand inspection requirements and communicate results effectively across functions

- Maintain accurate records of incoming sample lots, expected outcomes, reporting deadlines and priorities

- Perform daily, weekly and monthly tool-health checks, calibration and routine performance monitoring

- Troubleshoot tool and measurement issues and coordinate with equipment vendors to maintain tool availability

- Maintain an accurate inventory of consumables and spare parts required for reliable SEM operation

- Standardize measurement procedures and reporting methods to ensure consistent and repeatable results

- Document operating procedures and best practices and, over time, support the training of additional SEM operators

- Support the operation of additional defect-inspection tools and contribute to defect analysis and yield-improvement activities as the team grows

What You Bring

- Technical training or a bachelor’s or master’s degree in physics, chemistry, engineering, materials science or a related field

- Previous hands-on experience operating SEM systems

- Experience with FIB and EDX is highly desirable

- An understanding of sample preparation, imaging, measurement and basic failure-analysis methods

- Previous experience working in a semiconductor cleanroom is an advantage

- Willingness and ability to spend extended periods working in a cleanroom while wearing the required PPE

- Strong attention to detail and the ability to work carefully and consistently with sensitive samples and equipment

- A structured approach to documentation, sample tracking and task prioritization

- Confidence working in a dynamic environment with interconnected technical dependencies and changing priorities

- Good communication skills in English, with a reliable, open and honest approach to working with stakeholders

- Willingness to learn, take increasing ownership and support tasks beyond your immediate scope when needed

Preferred Qualifications

• Active AHIMA Certified Coding Specialist (CCS), AAPC Certified Inpatient Coder (CIC), AAPC Certified Professional Coder (CPC), or an RN / clinical credential with chart review or CDI experience.

• Thorough expertise in ICD-10-CM, ICD-10-PCS, and MS-DRG methodology, with hands-on experience in chart review, coding audit, or clinical documentation improvement (CDI).

• Experience reviewing charts in diverse settings, such as acute care, teaching hospitals, specialty units, surgical, trauma, oncology, cardiology, and transplant cases.

• Proficiency in reviewing various types of clinical documentation and identifying discrepancies or complex coding challenges.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, demonstrating meticulous attention to detail and clarity.

title: Channel Enablement Manager
description:
About the Role

Through the channel, a great product only wins when the partner knows how to sell it. At Abnormal, we want every partner ready to lead with the whole platform.

Abnormal is a channel-first company: nearly all of our transactions run through partners, which makes partner readiness a direct driver of revenue. As Channel Enablement Manager, you will own how our reseller, distributor, and referral partners learn to position, sell, and support the full Abnormal platform, and how our internal sellers work alongside them. We are expanding from email security into a multi-product behavioral platform spanning Identity, Insider Risk, and AI Security, so partners need to lead with the platform and grow every customer over time. You will be the person who makes that possible.

This is a high-visibility individual contributor role on the Sales Enablement team, working closely with Channel Leadership, Channel Account Managers (CAMs), and Channel SEs. You will build scalable, role-based partner enablement and certifications, deliver training people remember, and use data to prove that enabled partners generate more pipeline and win more deals. It is a role for someone who loves the craft of helping others succeed and wants to bring AI to the center of how enablement scales.

What You Will Do

• Build the framework. Design, build, and deliver a role-based partner enablement framework (Partner Essentials, Partner Sales 101, Pre-Sales 101, and advanced modules) through the Partner Portal and live sessions.

• Get partners productive faster. Lead partner onboarding that takes new and focus partners from signed to productive, with clear readiness milestones and certification paths.

• Train with impact. Deliver engaging in-person and virtual training to partner sellers, SEs, and leaders on Abnormal's value proposition, SEG displacement, discovery, qualification, and competitive positioning.

• Teach partners to sell the platform. Enable partners to sell Abnormal as a platform, with clear land-and-expand plays, cross-sell motions, and readiness for every new product launch.

• Prepare our own teams to co-sell. Enable Abnormal AEs, SDRs, and SEs on how to work with partners, including rules of engagement, deal registration, channel discounts, and renewal incumbency.

• Create the assets partners use. Partner with CAMs, Channel SEs, Channel Ops, Channel Marketing, and Product Marketing to deliver partner-facing sales plays, use cases, win wires, campaigns-in-a-box, and competitive intelligence.

• Let the data steer. Use performance data (partner-sourced pipeline, deal reg conversion, certification completion, win rates) to find gaps, prioritize investments, and report measurable impact.

• Scale with AI. Use AI to scale enablement and reduce CAM 1:1 training time, through AI-assisted content, roleplays, and on-demand coaching, so CAMs can focus on pipeline generation and partner-sourced revenue.

title: Redwood Automation Solution Designer (RunMyJobs / SAP BPA), SAP Finance Close, C
description:
Redwood Automation Solution Designer (RunMyJobs / SAP BPA), SAP Finance Close, Cyprus
Contract: Duration being confirmed. Start: 15 November 2026. Location: Remote, for consultants based in Cyprus. Day rate: EUR 400 a day. Language: English.
The programme
An established organisation is automating its SAP finance close on the Redwood platform, the same engine that runs RunMyJobs and that SAP sold for years as SAP Central Process Scheduling (CPS) and SAP Business Process Automation (BPA). The work covers the record-to-report cycle: accruals, balance sheet reconciliation, journal posting and the period-end close, all driven into SAP S/4HANA and ECC.
You will own the solution design. You will work with the finance process owners to understand how the close runs today, decide what to automate and in what order, and set out a design the engineers can build on the Redwood platform. You will then stay with that design through build, testing and go-live, and make the calls when what was designed meets what is real.
What you will work on
Current-state analysis of the SAP period-end close with controllers and finance operations leads. The target automation design: close task lists, dependencies, calendars, approvals and exception paths, written up as the solution design. Accruals, balance sheet reconciliation and certification, and journal posting with its posting controls. The integration design with SAP S/4HANA or ECC and the other source systems, through APIs, files and middleware. Security and controls designed in: role-based access, segregation of duties, audit trails and SOX-aligned evidence. Monitoring, recovery and the non-functional design that keeps the close running. Leading the engineers through build, and reviewing what they deliver against the design at design-authority and go-live checkpoints. Test strategy and acceptance criteria with the finance users.
What you bring
Solution design on the Redwood platform under any of its names: RunMyJobs, SAP BPA by Redwood, SAP CPS or Cronacle. Design of an automated SAP FI/CO period-end close, where you ran the design workshops and wrote the design yourself. Controls built into your designs: role-based security, segregation of duties, audit trails and SOX-aligned evidence. Leading engineers from an approved design through build, testing and go-live. 8 or more years in SAP finance systems, finance automation or record-to-report process design.
Useful but not essential:
Redwood Finance Automation (RunMyFinance). A BPA-to-RunMyJobs migration. CPS or Redwood tasks run from the SAP Financial Closing cockpit, or SAP Advanced Financial Closing. Financial services or another regulated industry.
How to respond
Apply with your CV and your available start date. With it, add three lines on your most recent Redwood or SAP close automation project: which Redwood product it ran on, the finance processes in scope, and which design decisions were yours.
About Yadimen
Yadimen Consulting Limited is an IT consulting company focused on financial services. For this programme we are putting experienced Redwood and SAP finance close automation people in front of the client.

title: Lead Web Designer
description:
About Us

Rho is the modern banking platform built for the AI era. Startups and growth-stage companies can open accounts in minutes, issue cards, manage expenses, pay bills, and close the books - all in one connected platform backed by real human support.

About the role

Most company websites are brochures. A hero, three feature tiles, a logo wall, a demo button. They get redesigned every few years and forgotten every few weeks in between.

Ours shouldn't be. For most founders, rho.co http://rho.co is the first time they meet us. It's where they decide whether we feel like a bank they'd trust with their company's money, long before they talk to anyone. That first impression is either doing the work for us or working against us.

We're hiring a Lead Web Designer to reimagine the entire site. Not a refresh. A rebuild of how Rho shows up in the world, from the homepage to every product page, pricing, our tools, our comparisons, our blog and our careers page.

We want rho.co http://rho.co to feel like the most considered financial brand on the internet. Calm, confident and alive. Restraint over decoration. Every page earns its place. If you've read this far and you're already thinking about what you'd change about our homepage, we should talk.

What you'll do

You'll own rho.co http://rho.co end to end. The story, the structure, the visual language, the motion and the details, all the way to production.

- Reimagine the whole site. Rethink the information architecture, the narrative and the visual system from first principles. What a founder needs to understand, in what order, and how it should feel.

- Make the product the hero. Show what Rho actually does with real, considered product moments rather than stock illustrations and vague promises.

- Build a system, not a set of pages. Define the layouts, type, color, components and motion that let the site scale across dozens of product, solution and comparison pages without losing its voice.

- Design in the real medium. You work in code and in our CMS, not just in static mocks. What you design is what ships.

- Sweat the details. Type that's set with care. Motion that has a reason. Pages that load fast and feel calm. The 404 page that somebody actually smiles at.

- Measure it. Partner with marketing and growth on what the site needs to achieve, and judge your work on whether more of the right founders sign up.

Who you are

You've been doing this for a while: at least 6 years designing and shipping marketing sites and brand experiences, with a portfolio that is visibly, unusually crafted. We need to see it. Live sites we can open, scroll and feel.

You are the kind of person who:

- Treats a website like a product. You think about structure, flow and outcomes, not just how a page looks in a screenshot.

- Has real typographic and editorial taste. You can make a page of words feel beautiful, and you know when to get out of the way.

- Brings motion with restraint. You know when an interaction makes a page feel alive and when it's just noise.

- Builds what you design. You're comfortable in code, a modern CMS, or both, and you care how the thing behaves on a phone at 7am on a slow connection.

- Can tell a complicated story simply. Banking, cards, treasury and bill pay are dense. You find the clear, human way to explain them.

- Can't turn your taste off. You notice the misaligned baseline on other people's sites, and you've rebuilt your own site more times than you'd admit.

Who this is not for

- Product designers who want a side project. This is a full time, high craft role focused entirely on the website.

- Template designers. If your best work is a theme with the logo swapped, this isn't the one.

- Anyone who needs the brief written for them. You'll help define what the site needs to say and do.

- People who think "good enough, ship it" is the standard for a homepage. Not here.

Our people are our most valuable asset. The salary range for this role is $110,000 - $150,000.

title: Site Budget & Contract Maintenance Specialist with DACH expertise
description:
Join Our Team and Help Keep Clinical Trials Moving

At Fortrea , we are committed to making clinical trials more efficient and helping bring life-changing therapies to patients.
As a Site Budget & Contract Maintenance Specialist , you will manage contracts and budgets for active clinical trial sites throughout the study lifecycle. This home-based opportunity is open to candidates located in Switzerland.

This role goes beyond initial contract and budget negotiation. You will assess the impact of protocol amendments and other study changes, establish timelines and priorities with study teams, and execute the required Clinical Trial Agreement (CTA) and budget amendments.

You will be part of our Functional Service Provider (FSP) team , working directly with one of our key pharmaceutical sponsors to support innovative clinical research.

Key Responsibilities
In this role, you will:

• Manage site contracts and budgets throughout the active study lifecycle , including ongoing maintenance and amendments.

• Review protocol amendments and other study changes , assess their impact on existing site contracts and budgets, and determine the actions required.

• Prepare, negotiate, and execute CTA and budget amendments with clinical trial sites.

• Partner with study leads to establish timelines, prioritize sites, and sequence amendment activities according to study needs.

• Manage a portfolio of active sites , tracking contract and budget changes, timelines, outstanding actions, and execution status.

• Communicate with sites and internal stakeholders regarding contractual and budgetary changes, resolving issues and escalating risks or delays when necessary .

• Maintain accurate documentation and status information in relevant systems, ensuring compliance with applicable procedures, contractual requirements, and clinical research standards.

Required Qualifications
To succeed in this role, you should have:

• Relevant experience in clinical trial site contracting and budgeting , ideally within a pharmaceutical company, Contract Research Organization (CRO), or similar clinical research environment.

• Demonstrated experience managing contracts and budgets after site activation , rather than experience limited to initial negotiation.

• Experience reviewing protocol amendments or other study changes and translating them into required contract and budget amendments.

• Strong understanding of Clinical Trial Agreements, site budgets, amendment processes, and the clinical trial lifecycle .

• Experience managing multiple active sites and competing priorities against study-specific timelines.

• Confidence working directly with sites, study teams, legal teams, and other stakeholders to resolve contractual or budget-related issues and escalations.

•
Fluency in German and English. Relevant university education is preferred, although equivalent relevant experience may be considered.

What We Offer

• The opportunity to work within an established FSP partnership supporting innovative clinical research.

• Flexible, home-based working arrangements in Switzerland.

• Professional development and career growth within a global clinical research organization.

• A collaborative environment with exposure to clinical study teams and cross-functional stakeholders.

• The opportunity to play a direct role in keeping active clinical trials and sites moving forward.

Ready to Make an Impact?

If you have strong clinical trial contracting and budgeting experience and enjoy managing the ongoing complexities of active studies , we would like to hear from you.

title: Insights Research Fellow
description:
Applications can come from any country in the world, and are not limited to geographies with B Lab or Sistema B offices.

The Strategy and Learning team at B Lab is committed to advancing research on B Corps and the B Corp movement. Following two successful rounds, we’re now seeking two to three new Research Fellows to join the program’s third cohort. These fellows will receive in kind support to explore their research questions using the full datasets B Lab has available, subject to necessary data protection steps and measures (see more on this below).

How to apply

In this call, B Lab is inviting scholars to submit a two-page proposal via this application portal explaining the questions they would like to explore using the wide range of B Lab data.

Including a resume is optional. Applications missing a proposal as outlined above will not be considered.

Number of fellowship openings

We’re looking to host 2-3 fellows from diverse geographies.

About B Lab B Lab ™ is the nonprofit behind Certified B Corporations™, a community of businesses that meet verified social, environmental, and governance standards. Together, our movement is working towards a more inclusive, equitable, and fair economic system.

Our history B Lab began in 2006 with the idea that a different kind of economy was not only possible - it was necessary. Our founders Andrew Kassoy, Bart Houlahan, and Jay Coen Gilbert believed there was a better way to do business: better for workers, better for communities, and better for the planet. When our movement’s first 81 Founding B Corps signed the Declaration of Interdependence in 2007, they were not just proposing a better way of doing business. They were proposing a different definition altogether.

What we’ve achieved B Lab became known for certifying B Corporations™, companies that meet verified standards of social and environmental performance, accountability, and transparency. But we do much more than that. We help mobilize a global community of businesses committed to collective action on society’s most critical challenges. In 2010, B Lab was part of successfully drafting and passing benefit corporation in Maryland, the first U.S. state to do so. This created a legal framework that allows companies to keep their values of care and community, not just shareholder value, at the forefront. Today, benefit corporation legislation is active in 52 jurisdictions around the world.

Our futureIn 2024, leaders from across the network agreed to evolve into a more integrated organization that embodies interdependence. This next iteration of our global network will balance global coherence with local agency to achieve our vision of economic systems change. We are now building this future together.

title: Economic Damages Expert Witness
description:
This is a remote position.

Economic Damages Expert Witness

Evidence Solutions , Inc. (ESI)
About Evidence Solutions , Inc. Evidence Solutions , Inc. is a nationally recognized expert witness and litigation support firm providing consulting across a wide range of civil and criminal matters. Our team partners with attorneys, insurance carriers, municipalities, corporations, and government entities to deliver credible, and defensible expert analysis.

We provide our experts with full-service support including marketing/business development, case intake and client support, billing and collections, allowing experts to focus on what they love doing best - working with the evidence.

Job Description:

We are seeking an experiencedEconomic Damages Expert Witnessto join our team of experts. This individual will serve as a consulting and testifying expert on cases involving economic damages, lost earnings, lost profits, business interruption, diminished earning capacity, related employment matters, life care plan costs, and other financial loss analyses. The ideal candidate will possess extensive experience in economics, forensic economic analysis, or financial damages assessment, along with exceptional analytical, communication, and report-writing skills. Candidates should be comfortable evaluating complex financial data, developing defensible economic damage models, and presenting opinions through written reports, depositions, and trial testimony.

This is an excellent opportunity for experienced economists and financial professionals interested in leveraging their expertise within the legal consulting and expert witness space while maintaining flexibility and autonomy.

Requirements

Responsibilities

• Provide consultation to attorneys and legal teams regarding economic and financial issues.

• Review financial records, tax returns, payroll records, business documents, and other case materials.

• Analyze and quantify economic damages using accepted economic principles and methodologies.

• Calculate lost earnings, lost profits, diminished earning capacity, business interruption losses, and future economic damages.

• Develop economic models and present value analyses to support damage calculations.

• Prepare detailed written expert reports, rebuttal reports, and case summaries.

• Provide expert witness testimony in depositions, and trials, translating complex economic concepts into clear and defensible opinions.

• Collaborate with ESI experts, internal case management and operations teams throughout the lifecycle of cases.

Qualifications

• Master's degree or Ph.D. in Economics, Finance, Business Economics, or a closely related discipline.

• 15+ years of professional experience in economics, forensic economics, economic consulting, valuation, or financial damages analysis.

• Prior expert witness experience preferred.

• Strong quantitative, analytical, and report-writing skills.

• Comfortable participating in depositions and testimony proceedings.

• Ability to communicate complex economic concepts clearly to attorneys, judges, and juries.

• High level of professionalism, objectivity, and attention to detail.

• Experience with forensic economics, business valuation, econometrics, or financial modeling is highly desirable.

• Professional credentials such as CFA, CPA, CVA, ASA, or ABV are a plus.

Benefits

Compensation & Structure

• 1099 independent contractor arrangement

• WFH

• Competitive hourly expert witness compensation

• Flexible case-based workload

• Consistent flow of cases through ESI's national client network

• Full administrative and operational support provided by ESI

• Experts retain autonomy while eliminating the burden of billing, collections, scheduling, and business development

Why Partner with ESI
What We Offer:

• Dedicated case management and administrative support from initial client intake to billing and collections that allows you to focus on doing what you love, delivering expert insights

title: Senior People Partner
description:
Who We Are:
Omaze lets people in the UK and Germany win luxury homes and other life-changing prizes while raising money for the causes they love. Our community has raised over £150 million for UK charities in five years, including Age UK, the RSPCA, British Heart Foundation and Great Ormond Street Hospital Charity.

🔑 ABOUT THE JOB

We are hiring a Senior People Partner to help our managers lead well. You will focus on leadership capability, how teams run, and programmes that measurably improve culture and performance. Within a year, our managers should set clearer expectations, handle underperformance earlier and need you less for what they can now do themselves.

You will partner with our managers and senior managers and report to our VP People. We’re a small team, so you will own your work from diagnosis through to adoption.

💪 WHAT YOU WILL HAVE DONE IN 12 MONTHS

- Manager capability you can see in the numbers. Managers set expectations, give feedback and address underperformance with confidence, and you can show the before and after.

- A real team problem fixed. You diagnosed an issue in structure, accountability or decision-making with the leader who owned it, and measured whether the fix worked.

- A change landed well. Leaders had a clear plan, people understood what was happening and why, and those affected had real support.

- A programme taken through to adoption. You owned it from diagnosis to rollout, and you reported honestly on whether it made a difference.

🫵 WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Coach and challenge managers. Build their confidence and capability in setting expectations, giving feedback, developing talent and addressing underperformance.

- Improve how teams work. Partner with leaders on team structure, capability, accountability and decision-making.

- Deliver people programmes. Diagnose the business need, propose practical solutions and own delivery through to adoption.

- Lead people change. Help leaders plan and implement organisational change, with clear communication and support for the people affected.

- Give sound advice on sensitive people matters. Bring empathy, commercial judgement and the confidence to challenge.

- Use AI well. Apply it in your own work and help managers do the same, with sound judgement on confidentiality and accuracy.

🎯 WHO THIS IS FOR

Experienced people partners who coach, diagnose and finish what they start. You have worked in an organisation of 300 or more people, or helped a smaller one grow through that size, so you know what good looks like at scale and when not to apply it.

- You have designed and delivered a people programme yourself and can show what changed, for example in manager effectiveness, engagement, regretted attrition or time to productivity.

- You coach managers well, and you can give examples of managers who became more effective and more independent because of you.

- You connect people issues to business priorities. You use data and employee insight to find causes, and you check whether your fix worked.

- You are comfortable with ambiguity, you prioritise hard, and you carry work through to completion in a lean team.

- You use AI in your daily work and can describe exactly how it has changed what you do. You also help others raise their own use, with good judgement on confidentiality and accuracy.

- You can tell us what you do differently now compared with 18 months ago, and why.

😢 WHO THIS IS NOT FOR

If your strength is policy administration, process ownership or running People Operations, this is not the right fit, because that work is covered elsewhere. If you want a large HR team to deliver through, you should also know this is a lean team and you will do much of the work yourself.

USEFUL BUT NOT REQUIRED

CIPD qualification. Experience in a growing business.

- 25 days annual leave PLUS Bank Holidays

title: Value & Access Senior Manager, 340B Analytics - U.S. Remote
description:
Career Category
Value and Access Job Description
Join Amgen ’s Mission of Serving Patients
At Amgen , if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission-to serve patients living with serious illnesses-drives all that we do.

Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas -Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease- we reach millions of patients each year. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline of medicines to treat cancer, heart disease, inflammatory conditions, rare diseases, and obesity and obesity-related conditions. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.
Value & Access Senior Manager, 340B Analytics (US Remote)
Live

What you will do
Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. The Value & Access Senior Manager leads forecasting, financial modeling and data analytics for Amgen ’s 340B Drug Pricing program. This role turns complex claims, payment and policy information into brand-level forecasts, scenario analyses and recommendations that support financial planning and business decisions. Working with Finance, Policy, Legal, Operations and Coverage & Pricing, you will also guide program strategy and execution as the external environment evolves.
Key job responsibilities:

• Lead the development and ongoing refinement of brand-level 340B forecasts and financial models, translating claims, utilization, pricing, channel and program assumptions into projected financial impact

• Build scenario and sensitivity analyses to quantify the potential effects of policy, market, utilization, channel and program changes; document assumptions and explain key forecast drivers

• Monitor for areas of anomalies and claim variances: alternative distribution models, duplicate discounts, emerging market changes

• Develop analytical capabilities to support 340B strategy and policy changes leveraging a wide variety of datasets and integrate emerging tools as relevant

• Analyze detailed claims, payment and related data to identify trends, validate inputs, resolve data issues and produce actionable insights for contracting, implementation and financial planning

• Manage the strategy and analytics for 340B duplicate discount scrubbing, assessing financial and operational impacts while supporting data integrity and compliance across claims and payment systems

• Partner with Finance, accounting and cross-functional stakeholders to align model assumptions, communicate findings to senior leaders and translate analysis into program and operational decisions

• Stay up to date on 340B news and policy changes

Win
What we expect of you
We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The strategic professional we seek is a collaborative partner with these qualifications.
Basic Qualifications:

• Doctorate degree and 2 years of 340B, pricing, healthcare policy, and/or other value and access experience; Or

title: Product Engineer
description:
eCarsTrade is a digital car marketplace serving professional buyers in more than 40 countries.
Through our online auction platform, we offer over 20,000 vehicles per week, sourced from leading fleet owners, leasing and rental companies, as well as banks and dealerships.
Over the last 3 years we have delivered 40% YoY profitable growth, building a leading market position in Europe.
Our platform keeps growing in scale and complexity. We want each part of the product to have one engineer who owns it end to end, from the business problem to the change in production and the effect on our users.

The Role
As a Product Engineer at eCarsTrade , you will own a part of our product end to end. You will learn the business process behind it and work directly with business stakeholders. Together you will decide what matters most. Then you will build it, ship it, and check whether it worked.
This is a hands-on role with high autonomy. Your working day might look like this: review the metrics and user feedback, talk to a stakeholder, decide what to do next, write and verify the code with AI coding agents, and release it to production (to everyone, to a share of users, or to a test group). The next day, you look at the results and do it again.
We are looking for a senior engineer who still writes code and also understands business. You should be comfortable making decisions and taking responsibility for the outcome. Responsibilities

• Own a product area end to end: understand the business process, the users, and the metrics that define success.

• Work directly with business stakeholders (sales, operations, remarketing, customer support) to find problems, agree on priorities, and decide what to build next.

• Design, implement, and maintain features across the backend, frontend, and infrastructure layers.

• Use AI coding agents professionally to write, review, test, and refactor code, keeping quality, security, and maintainability high.

• Ship changes to production in small, frequent increments using feature flags, gradual rollouts, and test groups.

• Measure the impact of every change on users and business metrics, and use the data to decide whether to iterate, scale up, or roll back.

• Monitor user feedback, production behaviour, and errors in your area, and act on what you find.

• Make pragmatic technical decisions that balance speed, reliability, and long-term maintainability.

• Help raise the engineering and product culture across the team by sharing practices around AI-assisted development, experimentation, and ownership.

Requirements

• 8+ years of hands-on software development experience, with strong PHP skills.

• Strong system design skills: experience designing applications and services from scratch, including architecture, data models, integrations, and trade-offs around scalability, reliability, and cost.

• Solid experience with relational databases (MySQL or similar): schema design, query optimization, and working with large datasets.

• Practical knowledge of infrastructure: Docker, CI/CD, queues, monitoring, and deploying and running production systems.

• Experience in a company with a strong engineering culture, and a track record of growing into a technical leadership role (Team Lead, Head of Development, CTO or similar).

• Proven ability to work directly with business stakeholders, translate business problems into technical solutions, and make product decisions together with them.

• A good understanding of product and business metrics (conversion, retention, revenue and similar) and experience using data to make decisions.

• Hands-on, professional experience using AI coding agents (e.g. Claude Code, Cursor, Codex or similar) in day-to-day development, including how to verify and take responsibility for AI-generated code.

• Broad technical knowledge and the judgement to choose the right tool for the problem.

• A high level of autonomy and ownership: you drive work to results without needing detailed instruction

SYSTRA is one of the world's leading engineering and consulting groups specializing in public transport and mobility solutions. For over 65 years, the Group has been committed to helping cities and regions develop by creating, improving and modernizing their transport infrastructure and systems.
Context
In India, SYSTRA is an international consulting and engineering company operating in the fields of Metros, High Speed Rail, Railways, Roads, Buildings, Urban planning, and Water & Environment for public and private organizations.
Our engineers work with passion to deliver the most reliable, cost-effective and made-to measures solutions allowing end users to move seamlessly.
SYSTRA ’s unique expertise is backed with a reputation built through technical excellence delivered on projects. Thanks to our know-how of our employees spread across India, we are present at all stages from upstream studies to operation and maintenance. We provide a comprehensive solution to manage all kinds of missions: Detailed Design Consultant, Project Management, Independent checking services.
SYSTRA India’s comprehensive know-how and expertise in Railways provides a wide spectrum of solutions for any challenge (Building a new rail link, doubling the capacity, gauge conversion, upgrading a network, improving the performance of existing lines, etc.).
Our extensive experience encompasses, Bridges, station buildings, Depots, Earthwork & Track Works, Power Supply and Transmission, Signaling & Telecommunications, Rolling Stock, Utilities diversion and yard re-modelling etc.
Our services cover the entire life cycle of the project implementation.
Currently, we are bidding for Metro projects across India. The position of Chief Tunnel Ventilation, Station Airconditioning Engineer is the key position in these BIDs.
Missions/Main Duties

• TVS Design Authority: Authorizing SES and CFD modeling to manage piston effects and heat loads in tunnels.

• Emergency Strategy: Designing critical fire-mode sequences to ensure smoke-free paths for passenger evacuation during emergencies.

• ECS & Station AC: Overseeing high-capacity chilled water plants, AHUs, and energy-efficient HVAC systems for public comfort and equipment cooling.

• System Integration: Coordinating the interface between Fire Alarms and the Environmental Control Panel (ECP) for automated emergency response.

• Physical Interface: Managing the placement of massive ventilation shafts and plant rooms with Civil and Architectural teams.

• Safety Validation: Leading full-scale Hot Smoke Tests and securing CMRS certification for station and tunnel safety.

• Operational Efficiency: Implementing VSDs and SCADA-linked monitoring to optimize massive power consumption.

Profile/Skills

• Graduate in relevant Engineering

• Required total 20+ years of experience

• 15+ years of experience in relevant projects.

We commit to put people who join us at the heart of improving transportation and urban infrastructure efficiency. As we are growing, this is time to be a part of this challenging adventure. It’s not a job - it’s a career!
